scan_linter_check.description:
Flags query() and get() calls on a GlideRecord inside the while (x.next()) loop of a different GlideRecord in the same function. The inner query runs once for every record of the outer query (the N+1 pattern), which is slow on large tables. Server-side scripts only.
Replaces the legacy check "NS: Nested GlideRecord Queries" (priority 2). It is a warning here: nested lookups are common and sometimes the right trade-off.
scan_linter_check.name: SN-GR-004: Query inside a query loop
scan_linter_check.resolution_details: Fetch the related records with one query before the loop (for example addQuery(field, 'IN', ids) or addJoinQuery) and look them up in an object, or use GlideAggregate. Nested queries run once per outer row.
scan_linter_check.short_description: A GlideRecord query runs inside another GlideRecord's while (x.next()) loop.
scan_linter_check.sys_name: SN-GR-004: Query inside a query loop
